descriptions.text: Safereum has conducted an exit scam for ~$1.3m. Contract Address: 0xb504035a11E672e12a099F32B1672b9C4a78b22f.

The Safereum team conducted a $1.3 million rug pull on October 23,24, 2023, by unlocking and selling nearly all SAFEREUM tokens from PinkLock, draining liquidity and rapidly crashing the token price by over 90%. The scam was enabled by the team's undisclosed retention of ownership and lock control. The Safereum team retained control over PinkLock contract settings and could immediately unlock and withdraw all SAFEREUM tokens. Users assumed liquidity was locked, but the unlock time was set to a few seconds instead of a meaningful lock, enabling an exit scam at will.
